Title: Create MATERIALIZED VIEW against ReplicatedMergeTree and Distributed tables
Description: I am trying to create VM for my cluster. before getting to the point here is the details:

I have 2 shards and 2 replicas in each.

Details:

cluster name: _clicks_cluster_

I have a replicated table:
```
CREATE TABLE default.clicks_replicated
(
    ...
)
ENGINE = ReplicatedMergeTree('/clickhouse/tables/{shard}/default/clicks_replicated', '{replica}')
PARTITION BY (...)
ORDER BY (...)
SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192;
```

Then I created the distributed from it:
```
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS default.clicks_distributed AS default.clicks_replicated
ENGINE = Distributed(clicks_cluster, default, clicks_replicated, cityHash64(my_column));
```

Now I want to create a VM.:

But I found out I don't get the new data if I create it against `clicks_distributed`  with `ENGINE = SummingMergeTree` 

Also creating it against `clicks_replicated` will lead to incomplete data per replica. 

what would be the query for creating VM in this case?
